title: Question bank file
description: One YAML file holds a list of questions under `questions`. Every question links to at least one objective ID from content/objectives/*.yaml.

meta.description: Optional provenance for the whole file.

id.description: Stable question ID, e.g. ASSOC-S2-Q001. Never reused once retired.

objective_ids.description: Objectives this question tests. Must resolve against the objective maps.

stem.description: The question itself. Scenario-based where possible - the real exams are.

code.description: Optional code or schema block shown with the stem.

correct.description: Exactly one correct option key. Multi-select is not modelled - neither exam uses it.

explanation.description: Why the correct answer is correct. Teach here; this is what the learner reads after answering.

distractor_rationale.description: Why each wrong option is wrong. Optional but strongly encouraged - misconceptions are where the learning is.

difficulty.description: recall = definition; application = apply to a scenario; analysis = diagnose or choose between trade-offs.

provenance.description: original: written for this repo. official-sample: retired sample published by Databricks in an exam guide. concept-inspired: concept taken from third-party material, question written from scratch - see docs/authoring-guide.md.

source_note.description: Required for official-sample and concept-inspired. Names the source, never quotes it.

variant_of.description: ID of the question this is a concise, harder rewrite of. Both share a primary objective. A timed test never includes a question and its variant together; the app treats the chain as one family.
